CustomField.description: True when the account is of the record type chosen in Record type for organizations (BarnCRM Settings, General), or has no record type when No record type is chosen: a blank record type, or the master record type, which has no developer name (canonical model R-O4, ADR-0141). Kept by BarnCRM: set when an account is saved, and on every account that disagrees by OrganizationFlagBatch when the setting changes and on each install. Read only to users. The Organizations list views and the record page rules for organizations use it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when this account is an organization: its record type is the one BarnCRM Settings uses for organizations.
CustomField.label: Is Organization
